Agent Skill.label: Agent Skill
Agent Skill.tip: A folder holding a SKILL.md: instructions that teach the AI how to handle one kind of task.

技能.label: skill
技能.tip: Short for Agent Skill. pstack is a pack of skills.

SKILL.md.label: SKILL.md
SKILL.md.tip: The body of a skill: a few header lines with its name and when to use it, then the steps and rules.

宿主.label: harness
宿主.tip: The tool that actually runs the AI: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and so on. pstack is installed inside it.

剧本.label: playbook
剧本.tip: The standard way to handle one kind of task. “Fix a bug” means reproduce, find the root cause, fix, verify.

poteto-mode.label: poteto-mode
poteto-mode.tip: pstack's main switch. You say what you want; it plans the steps itself.

子代理.label: subagent
子代理.tip: An AI helper the main conversation sends off to do one piece of work; it reports back only the conclusion.

worktree.label: worktree
worktree.tip: A second working folder for the same Git repo, so several AIs can change code at once without colliding.

待办清单.label: todo list
待办清单.tip: The list of steps /poteto-mode writes out at the start. Skipped steps say why.

验证技能.label: verification skill
验证技能.tip: A guide that teaches the AI to open your app and click through it like a user.

形式化验证.label: formal verification
形式化验证.tip: Instead of testing examples, checks that a rule holds in every possible case.

决策日志.label: decision log
决策日志.tip: One line per decision the AI makes: time, decision, reason, evidence. You read it in the morning.

原则.label: principles
原则.tip: pstack's 24 engineering principles. Each has a name; say the name to correct the AI.

token.label: tokens
token.tip: The unit AI usage is measured and billed in. pstack sends more subagents and runs more checks, so it uses more.

推理预算.label: reasoning budget
推理预算.tip: How long the model is allowed to think. Higher is more careful and more expensive. pstack defaults to xhigh.

PR.label: PR
PR.tip: Pull Request: a request to have a set of changes reviewed and merged into the main branch.

斜杠命令.label: slash command
斜杠命令.tip: A command typed in the chat starting with /, like /poteto-mode. It calls a skill by name.

模型角色.label: model roles
模型角色.tip: pstack splits work into roles (writing code, judging, reviewing…); each role can use a different model.

Custom Mode.label: Custom Mode
Custom Mode.tip: Cursor's persistent mode: the skill stays on every turn, so you don't type /poteto-mode each time.
